diagnosis: The scenario fails the Weak Arm gate because checks C1 and C2 are satisfied by the model through generic, safe decision-making patterns rather than the hidden information. Specifically, the model consistently assigns 'engineering_pallet' to 'V-1' and 'efrigerated_medical_crate' to 'V-3' in all rollouts, likely due to a heuristic of spreading cargo across all available vehicles (V-1, V-2, V-3) or simply selecting the first/last available options, thereby satisfying C1 (linked to PF2) and C2 (linked to PF1) without ever accessing those facts.

C1.why: The temporary V-2 payload limit changes the 3,800-kilogram engineering pallet assignment from V-2 being a nominally valid option to exactly V-1 and requires an action addressing V-2's payload limit or rear-suspension inspection.

C2.why: The approved V-3 inverter compatibility changes the refrigerated crate assignment from an otherwise open vehicle choice to exactly V-3 and requires a V-3 temperature-control or compatibility action.
